PROJECT OVERVIEW

The Commercial Challenge & Solution

HCP Nest connects leading hospitals, healthcare systems, and diagnostic centers with verified medical doctors, specialized surgeons, registered nurses, and clinical technicians. They needed a streamlined job board and talent portal allowing candidates to search verified medical positions and hospitals to post openings seamlessly.

Technical Challenge: High friction on mobile job searches led to an 80% candidate drop-off. Lack of Google for Jobs schema meant clinical openings were invisible in organic job search results.

ENGINEERING DELIVERABLES

Scope of Architecture Deployed

  • Interactive medical job search engine with specialty and location filtering
  • 1-click candidate application workflow with resume parsing integration
  • JobPosting & MedicalOrganization Schema markup for Google for Jobs
  • Hospital employer dashboard for posting vacancies and tracking applicants
  • Automated WhatsApp alerts for urgent clinical openings
